planSteps.description: The page heading reads "Wildlife Turnovers" and the subtitle mentions that endangered species get priority
A table lists turnovers, each row showing a tracking reference beginning WLD- and a species name
Open the first turnover in the list
The detail page shows the species, the turnover status, and a status history section

description: The wildlife turnovers queue lists turnovers by species with their WLD tracking references, and opening one shows its species, current status and status history.
